newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nucor Corp raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nucor Corp raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Michelle Galanter Applebaum said she raised her rating on Nucor Corp to strong buy from buy, citing the share price near its 52-week low and improving industry fundamentals.

-- "The critical factors in Nucor's near-term outlook include stronger steel prices, a reduction in startup expenses, and continued improvement in the operating rate of the company's Trinidad direct reduced iron operation," Applebaum said in a research note.
-- The stock was down 3/8 at 46-1/8 late Thursday morning.
